set_at.reason: Re-set from the observed maximum, the method the maintainer approved for `suite.full_seconds_ci_ubuntu_ctrace` (L-232), because the 2x-median rule would have given 2096 and let a leg twice today's median pass. Sample: every windows leg of 16 completed pr-gate runs, 2026-11-10 18:26Z to 2026-11-11 17:18Z (attempt 1; a job carried over unchanged into a re-run counted once; per job id in the PR), at 20,680 to 20,734 passing tests: 64 measurements, min 841.37, median 1047.72, p95 1243.54 (nearest rank), max 1414.92 s. Floor = max x 1.2, rounded up to 10 s = 1700: it clears the slowest observed leg by 285 s and still fails a leg about 62% slower than today's median. Floor = 459.54 x 1.2 = 551.4, rounded up to 560: it clears the slowest observed leg by 100 s and still fails a leg about 50% slower than the sample median. Cross-check (L-146): each C-tracer leg divided by the same run's ubuntu 3.13 leg (sysmon) ranges 0.97 to 2.34, median 1.56, with no step at any commit across the window, so the spread is the runner, not a code change. The 450 setting of 2026-10-21 rested on a 345.4 s median.
